description: For a tree whose height is a successor-limit ordinal, a branch is cofinal exactly when its node heights are unbounded in the tree height.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.cofinal_iff_unbounded.{u} (T : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.Tree)
  {B : Set T.carrier} (hB : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.IsBranch T B)
  (hlim : Order.IsSuccLimit (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.treeHeight T)) :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.IsCofinalBranch T B ↔
    ∀ a < Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.treeHeight T,
      ∃ t ∈ B, a < Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.nodeHeight T t
